theorem.coset_state_lift: For H<=K<=G, rho_H^G is rho_H^K tensored with a maximally mixed left-transversal coordinate, up to the coset-factorization unitary.
theorem.full_class_symmetrization: Uniform random S_(2n) conjugation maps every fixed m_alpha to the uniform full perfect-matching class and leaves the null invariant.
theorem.prior_art_scope: The rigid-GI HSP construction and K-versus-S_(2n) sampling equivalence are explicitly given in arXiv:quant-ph/0501056.
theorem.rigid_union_hidden_subgroup: For two rigid n-vertex graphs, the disjoint-union automorphism subgroup is trivial when nonisomorphic and {1,m_alpha} when isomorphic.
theorem.scope_limit: Nonrigid graph pairs, general GI, efficient binary measurement, and a classical separation remain unproved.
theorem.search_decoding: Identifying m_alpha directly recovers its cross-block matching and therefore the unique graph isomorphism alpha.
theorem.structured_involution_embedding: m_alpha swaps the two n-point blocks through alpha and alpha^-1, so it is a fixed-point-free involution in S_(2n).
theorem.wreath_subgroup: All m_alpha lie in K=S_n wr C_2 and form the structured K-conjugacy class indexed by alpha in S_n.

theorem_contract.outside_scope: Nonrigid graphs and arbitrary graph automorphism subgroups.
theorem_contract.solver_contract: Worst-case full-class binary detector for decision; full-class identifier for recovery of the unique isomorphism.
theorem_contract.source_problem: Rigid Graph Isomorphism for two explicitly represented n-vertex graphs.
theorem_contract.source_promise: Both graphs have trivial automorphism groups.
theorem_contract.target_access: Coherent relabeling oracle and independently preparable coset states from the standard disjoint-union automorphism HSP.
theorem_contract.target_problem: Null versus fixed-point-free order-two HSP in S_(2n).
